SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS ActualSalesRevenue,
    sum(fsq.SalesAmountQuota) AS BudgetSalesRevenue,
    ActualSalesRevenue - BudgetSalesRevenue AS Variance,
    round(if(BudgetSalesRevenue != 0, (ActualSalesRevenue / BudgetSalesRevenue) * 100, NULL), 2) AS ActualVsBudgetPct
FROM retail.DimProductCategory pc
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ProductKey, sum(SalesAmount) AS SalesAmount
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY ProductKey
) fs ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ProductKey, sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS SalesAmountQuota
    FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY ProductKey
) fsq ON fsq.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY ActualSalesRevenue DESC
